acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen cabinet upgrades in the Berkeley and East Bay area is highly variable, influenced by the scope, materials, and labor involved. Refacing cabinets is typically more budget-friendly than replacement, while custom cabinets represent a higher investment due to specialized design and craftsmanship. Factors such as the size of your kitchen, the chosen wood species, finishes, and hardware also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation, ensuring transparency regarding material costs and labor for your specific project within the East Bay region.
